description: This file defines the Java class 'ContactAccessorSdk5' which extends 'ContactAccessor' and provides implementations for picking a contact intent and loading contact information from the Android contacts provider API.

classes.name: ContactAccessorSdk5
classes.description: A concrete implementation of ContactAccessor that uses the Android Contacts API to access contact data, tailored for API level 5 (Eclair) or higher, enabling contact selection and data retrieval.

methods.name: getPickContactIntent
methods.description: Returns an Intent configured to launch the contact picker using the Contacts CONTENT_URI.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact details (display name and phone number) from the provided contact Uri using ContentResolver queries.

calls: contentResolver.query(contactUri, new String[]{Contacts._ID, Contacts.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)
contentResolver.query(Phone.CONTENT_URI, new String[]{Phone.NUMBER}, Phone.CONTACT_ID + "=" + contactId, null, Phone.IS_SUPER_PRIMARY + " DESC")
